checkpoint_finding.source_revision_warning: The source code postdates all current graph datasets but contains no biological weights. Exposure is determined by each immutable local graph and training receipt, not code chronology.

held_source_feasibility.feasible_design: Remove one evidence source before graph construction and fit a generic candidate-gene scorer from remaining relations. The isolated evaluator later measures whether that ranking recovers support in the removed source.
held_source_feasibility.relation_specific_failure: RGCN relation transforms and a DistMult-style decoder relation embedding for a wholly absent type are untrained. Querying them would produce initialization-dependent scores, not evidence transfer.
held_source_feasibility.seal_status: No current evidence source is project-sealed. Leave-one-source-out evaluation remains retrospective development evidence regardless of split cleanliness.

known_leakage_routes: Constructing nodes or the candidate universe from genes, variants, loci, or assays present only in the held source.

Retaining held-source inverse edges, source nodes, aliases, observability, tested status, coverage, missingness, prevalence, degrees, source counts, paths, metapaths, normalization statistics, or edge-derived node features.
Computing graph embeddings, centrality, positional features, negative pools, feature scaling, or early-stopping signals before source and locus removal.
Using a held relation ID in the decoder or interpreting randomly initialized held-relation parameters as predictions.
Using untestable, not-applicable, unavailable, indeterminate, or merely absent edges as negatives.
Letting current Gene Catalog memberships, provisional corrected-COLOC outcomes, frozen 117 programs, or hero genes define targets, hyperparameters, or calibration.
Adding an external knowledge graph without tracing whether it already contains project COLOC, MPRA, CROP-seq, Gene Catalog, or deterministic derivative edges.
Reporting seeds, edges, genes, variants, cells, or guides as independent replicates instead of resampling LD and gene blocks.

license_disposition.project_weights: No upstream restriction, but redistribution remains conditional on every graph source's terms and project derivative-use review.

remaining_blockers: Complete and explicitly promote the corrected 50-study COLOC release, then freeze one graph snapshot, evidence ontology, canonical node universe, source aliases, native-build LD and locus groups, and source provenance.
Freeze feature-based versus entity-ID mode. Any inductive claim requires feature-based input and a query fixture for unseen nodes; node-index mode is transductive.

Freeze relation and inverse-relation order, RGCN depth, dimensions, basis or block decomposition, aggregation, dropout, sampler, generic decoder, negatives, optimizer, early stopping, calibration, and five seeds.
Implement a source-removal constructor that deletes every held-source outcome, coverage signal, deterministic derivative, and held-locus message-passing path before any fitted transform.

Prove on synthetic fixtures that source-only nodes disappear, untestable edges never become negatives, inverse and alias leakage fail closed, relation permutation preserves semantics, and an unseen relation-specific decoder is rejected.
Freeze tensor-only model artifacts, graph and training receipts, environment, predictions, calibration, and hashes for every split and seed.
Run import, forward/backward, local fit, save/resume, seed determinism, sampler, relation-order, CPU/L40S tolerance, and reproduction probes only through an approved SLURM campaign.
Keep all graph results development-only until a wholly sealed evidence source is registered and powered before outcomes are read.
